## Workflows

::: {.workflow-tables}
### Benzene as the screening reference

Benzene, a small aromatic molecule with a measured gas-phase spectrum, establishes the screening calculation and the B3LYP and DD-DFT comparison before the dyes.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Accepted](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/check.svg "Accepted"){.workflow-status} | 17 Oct 2026 | [Benzene electronic screening $\varepsilon_s$](2026-10-17_122144/) | Converges the electronic screening $\varepsilon_s$ with Lotus screened Slater exchange in the $6\text{-}31\mathrm{G}$ basis, at the fixed geometry of the supplied example. |
| ![Rejected](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/cross.svg "Rejected"){.workflow-status} | 21–23 Oct 2026 | [[Benzene with checkpoint-chained guesses](2026-10-21_164931/)]{.rejected} | [Compares B3LYP and DD-DFT screening and $S_0\rightarrow S_n$ absorption with the gas-phase spectrum, each Gaussian step reading the previous step's checkpoint.]{.rejected} |
| ![Accepted](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/check.svg "Accepted"){.workflow-status} | 29–30 Oct 2026 | [Benzene with independent guesses](2026-10-29_183718/) | Rebuilds the same comparison from logged coordinates and default guesses, checking wavefunction stability and recording energies and orbital gaps. |

### Methoxy difluoroboron chelate (1)

Structure 1 of Saito et al. (2023), whose absorption and emission were measured in five solvents, tests the comparison on a donor–acceptor dye in IEFPCM acetonitrile.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Rejected](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/cross.svg "Rejected"){.workflow-status} | 21–26 Oct 2026 | [[Methoxy difluoroboron chelate (1) with checkpoint-chained guesses](2026-10-21_164940/)]{.rejected} | [Compares B3LYP and DD-DFT absorption and $S_1$ relaxation with the measured spectra, each Gaussian step reading the previous step's checkpoint.]{.rejected} |
|  | 28 Oct 2026 | Methoxy difluoroboron chelate (1) with independent guesses | Rebuilds the same comparison from logged coordinates and default guesses, checking wavefunction stability and recording energies and orbital gaps. |

### Dimethylamino difluoroboron chelate (3)

Structure 3 of the same paper replaces the methoxy donor with dimethylamino, whose TICT emission separates the effect of donor substitution.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Rejected](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/cross.svg "Rejected"){.workflow-status} | 21 Oct 2026 | [Dimethylamino difluoroboron chelate (3)]{.rejected} | [Prepares the checkpoint-chained screening, absorption and $S_1$ relaxation sequence; superseded before submission.]{.rejected} |
:::
